author: Kusha N M
raw:
ತಿಳಿದ ವೃದ್ಧನೆ ಆಗಿ ವಯಸಿನಲು ಹಿರಿಯನಿರೆ
ಕಳೆಸಮಯ ಕಿರಿಯರಿಗೆ ಆದರ್ಶವಾಗಿ
ಉಳಿಸೆ ಮಾನವಧರ್ಮ ನಿರತ ತತ್ಪರನಾಗೆ
ಅಳಿಲುಸೇವೆಯೆ ನಿನದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you are old in years, be an elder who knows;
spend your time as an ideal for the young;
if you are ever ready to preserve the dharma of humanity,
even a squirrel’s service is yours, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Age should bring wisdom. Spend later years as an example to the young and in service of humanity. Even a small contribution, like the squirrel’s help to Rāma, counts.
